Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: Relied on an unverified DuckDuckGo snippet that incorrectly listed the death place as “Bombay, Bombay Presidency, British India” for 1990 (anachronistic and wrong), instead of opening the source to confirm.
